title: 230127 Raccoon calls, noisy world, EMT272s, roof, Toronto 10pm
author: TRP
changes: A wild common raccoon (Procyon lotor) giving trilling, chittering calls at night in Toronto. Trimmed to 1.20–4.10 s of the original, mixed to mono, gentle 12 dB/oct high-pass at 150 Hz, silence trimmed, loudness-normalised (≈ −18 dBFS RMS, peak ≤ −1 dBFS), peaks limited by 0.8 dB, 10 ms fade-in / 120 ms fade-out, encoded as 96 kbps mono MP3. Taken from the Freesound high-quality MP3 preview of the recording. The high-pass removes measured city traffic rumble below 200 Hz.
